proto.item: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (brain, camera, mic)
N20 6 V metal gearmotor with hall encoder
Pololu DRV8833 dual motor driver carrier
VL53L0X ToF board (front + both cliff sensors on the proto)
5 V 2 A buck regulator (Pololu D24V22F5 class)
Perfboard, JST leads, 10-wire ribbon, slide switch
Charge contacts (2 brass pads) + dock USB-C breakout + 2 pogo springs
PETG filament (~320 g incl. dock) + TPU (~40 g)

volume.item: ESP32-S3 module (N8R8) on the head board
Micro servo (SG90 class, custom lead length)
Main board: 2-layer 44x70, DRV8833, ICM-42670-P, IP2326, buck, MAX98357A, USB-C, switch
Head board: ESP32-S3 + display/camera FFC connectors
Injection-molded parts (shells, core, head, visor, 2 hubs)
Wiring: 10-wire ribbon, motor leads, contacts, fasteners
Dock: molded puck, 2 spring contacts, USB-C board
Contingency: yield loss, scrap, price drift (8%)

bom.tooling: One-time: about $38k-55k for 8 steel/aluminium tools (shell front/rear, core, head, visor, hub, tyre, dock), FCC/CE/UN38.3 testing about $20k-30k.

part:shell_front.title: Body shell, front
part:shell_front.desc: Front half of the bean-shaped body: chest speaker grille, brow window for the range sensor, two cliff-sensor eyes. Splits from the rear half on one flat plane, so it is a simple straight-pull tool.

part:shell_rear.title: Body shell, rear + kickstand tail
part:shell_rear.desc: Rear half with the upturned tail moulded in. To park, Teeterkin leans back onto the tail: motors off, zero power, and the charge pads in the tail land on the dock.

part:core.title: Core frame
part:core.desc: The one structural part: motor saddles, battery cradle, spine for the main board, servo cradle and the mast sleeve. Every bought part mounts to it before the shells close.

part:head.title: Head + periscope mast
part:head.desc: Head shell, hollow mast and scotch-yoke bar in a single moulding. The servo crank runs in the yoke slot and lifts the whole head 38 mm.

part:visor.title: Smoked visor (face)
part:visor.desc: Clear smoked polycarbonate. The display reads through it as glowing eyes; switched off it is a glossy black face.

part:hub_l.title: Wheel hub
part:hub_l.desc: Five-spoke hub in the accent colour, press-fit on the 3 mm D-shaft. Same tool both sides.

part:hub_r.title: Wheel hub
part:hub_r.desc: Five-spoke hub in the accent colour, press-fit on the 3 mm D-shaft. Same tool both sides.

part:tyre_l.title: Tyre
part:tyre_l.desc: TPU 85A tyre with a fine chevron tread: grip on wood and tile, quiet on the floor.

part:tyre_r.title: Tyre
part:tyre_r.desc: TPU 85A tyre with a fine chevron tread: grip on wood and tile, quiet on the floor.

part:dock.title: Charging dock
part:dock.desc: Low oval puck with a cup the tail drops into and two spring contacts. Teeterkin backs up, leans back, charges. USB-C in.

elec:motor_l.title: N20 gearmotor 100:1 + hall encoder
elec:motor_l.desc: Metal-gear N20, 100:1, 3 mm D-shaft, 7-PPR magnetic encoder (700 counts per wheel turn). Run from the 2S pack with a PWM ceiling: about 0.7 m/s top speed on 72 mm wheels.

elec:motor_r.title: N20 gearmotor 100:1 + hall encoder
elec:motor_r.desc: Metal-gear N20, 100:1, 3 mm D-shaft, 7-PPR magnetic encoder (700 counts per wheel turn). Run from the 2S pack with a PWM ceiling: about 0.7 m/s top speed on 72 mm wheels.

elec:cell_1.title: 18650 Li-ion cell 2600 mAh
elec:cell_1.desc: Two cells in series (2S, 7.4 V, 19 Wh). Lying across the body just above the axle: their weight sets the pendulum that the balance loop rides on. About 3 h of active play, 20 h idle (estimate).

elec:cell_2.title: 18650 Li-ion cell 2600 mAh
elec:cell_2.desc: Two cells in series (2S, 7.4 V, 19 Wh). Lying across the body just above the axle: their weight sets the pendulum that the balance loop rides on. About 3 h of active play, 20 h idle (estimate).

elec:pcb.title: Main board
elec:pcb.desc: One 44 x 70 mm board on the back of the spine: motor driver, IMU, 2S charger + protection, 5 V buck, audio amp, USB-C. The brain lives in the head.

elec:drv8833.title: DRV8833 dual H-bridge
elec:drv8833.desc: Drives both N20s at 25 kHz PWM, 1.2 A per channel; balance loop runs at 500 Hz.

elec:imu.title: ICM-42670-P 6-axis IMU
elec:imu.desc: Gyro + accelerometer for the balance loop. Board sits on the body centreline, 26 mm above the axle.

elec:charger.title: 2S USB-C charger + protection
elec:charger.desc: IP2326-class boost charger (5 V USB-C in, 8.4 V out) plus 2S protection with balancing.

elec:buck.title: 5 V 2 A buck regulator
elec:buck.desc: Pack to 5 V for the servo, the amp and the head. 3.3 V is made on the XIAO.

elec:amp.title: MAX98357A I2S amplifier
elec:amp.desc: Class-D mono, 3 W, drives the chest speaker for chirps, purrs and speech.

elec:usbc.title: USB-C port
elec:usbc.desc: Right-angle receptacle on the back of the board. Charging (when not on the dock) and firmware.

elec:switch.title: Power switch
elec:switch.desc: Slide switch: hard power cut for shipping and storage.

elec:pogo_l.title: Charge contacts in the tail
elec:pogo_l.desc: Two gold-plated pads flush in the underside of the tail. Parking on the dock = leaning back onto them: no alignment mechanism needed.

elec:tof.title: VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor
elec:tof.desc: Forward laser ranging to 2 m behind the brow window: obstacles, "someone is in front of me", following distance.

elec:cliff_l.title: Cliff sensor
elec:cliff_l.desc: IR reflective sensor (ITR8307 class) looking down and ahead of each wheel: stops at stairs and table edges.

elec:cliff_r.title: Cliff sensor
elec:cliff_r.desc: IR reflective sensor (ITR8307 class) looking down and ahead of each wheel: stops at stairs and table edges.

elec:servo.title: SG90 micro servo (periscope lift)
elec:servo.desc: The only actuator besides the wheels. Through the scotch yoke it pops the head up 38 mm in 0.25 s: peek, duck, nod, bounce.

elec:horn.title: Servo horn + yoke pin
elec:horn.desc: Ships with the servo; an M2 shoulder screw is the crank pin running in the head yoke slot.

elec:speaker.title: Speaker 28 mm
elec:speaker.desc: 8 ohm 1 W, firing through the chest grille.

elec:xiao.title: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense (brain)
elec:xiao.desc: Dual-core ESP32-S3, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi + BLE. Runs the balance loop, behaviours, face animation, wake word and the camera stream; heavier AI is offloaded to the phone app.

elec:camera.title: Camera (OV3660 on the XIAO Sense)
elec:camera.desc: 3 MP camera looking out through the smoked visor below the face. With the head raised it sees over sofa arms and table tops.

elec:mic.title: PDM microphone (on the XIAO Sense)
elec:mic.desc: Wake word ("hey kin") and sound events like a doorbell, a dog bark or glass breaking.

elec:lcd.title: 2.0" IPS display 320 x 240 (the face)
elec:lcd.desc: ST7789 SPI panel behind the smoked visor: two big animated eyes and a mouth line. Off = the visor looks black and glossy.

elec:touch.title: Touch pads (ears)
elec:touch.desc: Copper pads under the two ear domes, read by the ESP32-S3 touch pins: pat its head, it purrs.

elec:flex.title: Head cable (10-wire)
elec:flex.desc: 10-way ribbon down the hollow mast: 5 V, ground, I2C (IMU), I2S (amp), motor PWM, encoder, servo. Service loop below the mast.
